other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a registered farmer (individual or joint land holder) or a child (son/daughter) of a registered farmer or the farmer’s spouse
Death or permanent disability must be caused by an accident
Applicant must submit the application within 150 days of the death or accidental disability
Suicide or natural death are not covered
Beneficiary succession follows the order: spouse, children, parents, grandchildren, unmarried/widow/exiled sister, then other heirs as per the Heirs Act
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,00,000 assistance for accidental death or permanent disability, and 50% (₹1,00,000) assistance for loss of one eye or one limb.
